seo_title: Find International Student Scholarships in USA
seo_description: International student scholarships in the USA with deadlines, award details, and eligibility to compare. Explore listings and apply on provider application paths.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships for international students in the current cycle usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and subject areas fast. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of listings tied to that search, so you can compare options for education, STEM, arts, community, medicine, and other academic paths without jumping between unrelated results. The rows below include programs that may fit graduate students, college students, and some earlier study stages, but requirements are not uniform. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and essay expectations are mixed, so it is worth reading each row closely before you apply.
h1: Compare International Student Scholarships in USA
supporting: A smart way to use this list is to compare the requirement line, study level, category tags, and deadline text side by side before opening individual listings. Some programs may look broader, while others are clearly tied to a field such as engineering, education, business, English, or health professions. If you want to find scholarships worth pursuing first, scan for matches on citizenship or residency wording, then review the full rules on the provider application path. That extra check matters because award details, application materials, and timing can change from one program to the next.
related_intro: If you do not find the right fit here, related scholarship pages can help you narrow by study level, subject area, or requirement style. That is useful when you want to compare international student options in the USA against broader education or STEM listings.

faq.question: Can I compare award amounts and deadlines across these scholarship listings?
faq.answer: Yes—these rows include deadline text, and many listings show award amounts, but both can vary a lot by program. Treat the catalog as a organized ScholarshipTop workspace and review the latest amount, deadline, and renewal terms on the provider application path before you apply.

faq.question: What kinds of scholarships can I explore in this filtered list?
faq.answer: The programs below span categories such as Education, STEM, Miscellaneous, Community, Medicine, and Arts, with sample fields including education, business, engineering, English, and health professions. Study levels also vary, so you can browse for options that better match your academic stage.

faq.question: Do these USA scholarship listings all require essays?
faq.answer: No single rule applies across this page—some listings may ask for essays, while others may be lighter-touch. Review each scholarship's application requirements before you start an application, especially since deadlines differ by program and some dates may be coming up soon.
